children: halted production of its F-150 pickup truck at a plant near Detroit, according to a memo spotted by Reuters. All shifts for production crews at Dearborn Truck Plant were canceled through September 29, according to the memo.
Sources indicate production of the F-150 truck at other plants was also impacted by the same unspecified issue.
Last year, fires at supplier Novelis’s New York aluminum plant disrupted material for Ford's
F-150 and other F-Series trucks. The plant restarted its hot mill in June 2026, and Ford

has since increased production, although dealer inventory remained below its target in early September. Looking further back, a semiconductor shortage caused repeated pauses or reduced schedules for F-150 production, including at Dearborn in 2021 and Kansas City in 2022.

title: Ford F-150 production halted at a Detroit plant
